summary: The Basel Committee on Banking Supervision published a review of how jurisdictions implement a positive neutral countercyclical capital buffer (PNR-CCyB), a macroprudential tool that maintains a non-zero buffer rate even when systemic risks are neither subdued nor elevated. Based on a 2023 survey of jurisdictions, the paper documents the legal frameworks, calibration techniques, and operational procedures for building, releasing, and replenishing these buffers. The document finds that an increasing number of jurisdictions have adopted this approach to increase resilience and provide more capital that can be released during crises.
